[[Maz's Chest]] will spawn after defeating [[Maz Scourgeheart]] in the final level of the [[Forsaken Tunnels]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list with a small chance of an additional bonus drop of 1-2 items. After the chest has been opened, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

==Notes==
* [[Weapon]]s dropped by this chest will always be [[Item rarity|uncommon]] (purple) or [[Item rarity|rare]] (gold), [[inscribable]], and can have maximum damage, armor, or energy values.
* If [[Devona]] is present as a hero in the party, her level does not influence the chest's drops.
* Similar to how the presence, level, and skills of some Charr foes in the dungeon and the rewards of this chest scale with that of the lowest-leveled player in the party, the size of the chest increases as well.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260407|April 7, 2026 update]], [[dye]]s dropped by the chest did not stack with dyes dropped by foes, and had a higher sale value of 25 {{gold}} to merchants.
* This chest is the only source of maximum damage weapons (with the exception of [[Bonus item]]s which cannot be traded) and the only source of rare weapons (and as such the only source of [[perfect]] [[upgrade component]]s) in pre-Searing Ascalon.
